label: FRED series
description: Fetch a FRED macro time series (observations) via St. Louis Fed API for downstream compose

description_i18n.en: Fetch a FRED macro time series (observations) via St. Louis Fed API for downstream compose
description_i18n.zh_CN: 通过圣路易斯联储 FRED API 拉取宏观时间序列观测值，供下游成文
description_i18n.zh_HK: 透過聖路易斯聯儲 FRED API 拉取宏觀時間序列觀測值，供下游成文

propose_guide: Use when NL asks for FRED macro series (rates, CPI, DGS10, DXY proxies, etc.). Requires Vault fred/series API key. Set series_id from NL.

propose_guide_i18n.en: Use when NL asks for FRED macro series (rates, CPI, DGS10, etc.). Requires Vault API key. Set series_id from NL.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 当需要 FRED 宏观序列（利率、CPI、DGS10 等）时使用。需 Vault API key。从自然语言设置 series_id。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 當需要 FRED 宏觀序列（利率、CPI、DGS10 等）時使用。需 Vault API key。從自然語言設定 series_id。

params.name: series_id
params.description: FRED series id, e.g. DGS10, CPIAUCSL
